_meta.description: Machine-derived 'what would be placed next' table for the top-performing usernames of the repository's own paper competitions. Orders are mechanical replays of frozen models on committed vendor bars; sizes are indicative and computed from the official rule constants at the last captured close.
_meta.sizing_note: Indicative sizes use the official rule constants only: futures = 250,000 x 20 buying power with the section-08 per-symbol cap; stocks edition = 100,000 x 1 with a 50-unit cap. Actual size in a live account depends on the real equity and the fill price.
_meta.honesty_note: This is a simulation of mechanical rules on vendor history for a PAPER competition. It is not investment advice, not a forecast, and not a claim that any of these orders would win a prize. Historical and simulated returns do not imply future results.

futures.price_source: data/market_history/ (vendor daily bars, front-month continuous futures)

recommendations.entry_condition: Contrarian capitulation entries followed by full-reinvestment pyramiding every 1 ATR of favourable drift concentrate capital into the rare explosive reversals the placement arithmetic requires.

pending_orders.order_type: market at the next bar open of the same series
pending_orders.sizing_rule: the exit leg closes the position the model already holds; the entry leg is sized by the rule below
pending_orders.indicative_size_note: indicative only: computed from the last captured close and the official rule constants; the actual fill price at the next open is unknown

recommendations.entry_condition: A multi-day collapse (or euphoria run) that stretches price by >=1 ATR over 3 closes with ATR expanding is over-extended and mean-reverts over the next ~10 sessions.
recommendations.waiting_for: A multi-day collapse (or euphoria run) that stretches price by >=1 ATR over 3 closes with ATR expanding is over-extended and mean-reverts over the next ~10 sessions.

recommendations.entry_condition: A range-expansion exhaustion bar (true range >= 2x ATR with the close pinned in the extreme quartile of the bar) marks liquidation climax; the next sessions revert.
recommendations.waiting_for: A range-expansion exhaustion bar (true range >= 2x ATR with the close pinned in the extreme quartile of the bar) marks liquidation climax; the next sessions revert.

recommendations.entry_condition: An opening gap larger than 1.5 ATR(14) is over-reaction, not information: fading the gap direction captures the close-the-gap drift over ~5 sessions.

pending_orders.order_type: market at the next bar open of the same series
pending_orders.sizing_rule: close the open position; no new size
pending_orders.indicative_size_note: an exit leg carries no size: it closes whatever the position is

stocks_daily.price_source: data/intraday/ (1d vendor bars for the 20-stock volatile pool)

recommendations.entry_condition: A close above the 20-session high while ATR(14) itself expands (>=1.2x its value 5 bars ago) is a volatility-backed breakout rather than a thin-air print; pyramiding every 0.5 ATR compounds the expansion phase.

pending_orders.order_type: market at the next bar open of the same series
pending_orders.sizing_rule: 50 units max per instrument (official stocks-edition cap); balance 100,000 x leverage 1
pending_orders.indicative_size_note: indicative only: computed from the last captured close and the official rule constants; the actual fill price at the next open is unknown

recommendations.entry_condition: Extreme volatility compression (20-day standard deviation <= 1.2 ATR) followed by a >=2.5x volume expansion breakout signals institutional accumulation; buying the breakout and pyramiding every 1 ATR captures explosive multi-day trending expansions.

recommendations.entry_condition: A new N-bar low that the next bar immediately reclaims (close back above that low on >=2x volume, close in the top half of its range) is a failed breakdown / spring; the snapback is harvested long with pyramiding.
